shared_elements: large upright stone slab with rounded/irregular top
figures organised in stacked horizontal registers
horizontal dividing band or frame line separating registers
row of repeated similar figures along the top register
animals/figures rendered against a plain ground with no landscape
justification: The most specific correspondence is the shared compositional logic: a tall stone whose face is divided by horizontal bands into stacked registers, with a top register of repeated near-identical forms above larger profile animals or figures. The biggest difference is the manner of rendering — A is weathered low-relief carving with rounded, plastic animal bodies read by light and shadow, whereas B presents flat, hard-edged black silhouettes with a knotted interlace border, a graphic idiom with no counterpart in A.
